Package com.cg.training.daoImplementation

Class LoanDAOImplementation

java.lang.Object
com.cg.training.daoImplementation.LoanDAOImplementation
All Implemented Interfaces:
LoanDAO
public class LoanDAOImplementation extends Object implements LoanDAO
LoanDAOImplementation provides an in-memory and file-based implementation of the LoanDAO interface. It supports adding, completing, retrieving, and persisting loan records.

Loans are saved and loaded from the file located at resources/loans.txt.

Author:
Debangshu Mandal

    • saveLoansToFile

      public void saveLoansToFile()
      Saves all current loans to a file for persistence.

      Each loan is serialized as a line in the format: memberId;memberName;memberEmail;bookTitle;bookAuthor;bookCount;loanStatus

      Specified by:
      saveLoansToFile in interface LoanDAO
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if an I/O error occurs during saving
